ideas.pitch: An offline AI-powered code analysis tool running directly on Snapdragon NPUs to provide instant, privacy-first security and performance feedback for local developers.
ideas.title: SnapDragon Edge AI Code Reviewer
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly leverages Qualcomm hardware advantages and builds on the proven pattern of winning the Qualcomm Snapdragon Multiverse Hackathon.

ideas.pitch: An autonomous 5-layer multi-agent IoT diagnostic and closed-loop operations platform powered by edge intelligence and vector databases for rapid industrial anomaly detection.
ideas.title: Multi-Agent IoT Diagnostic Mesh
ideas.why_it_could_win: Combines advanced multi-agent workflows with IoT telemetry, aligning with hardware-software integration themes favored in Qualcomm collaborations.

ideas.pitch: A full superscalar RV32I out-of-order processor implemented in Verilog featuring Tomasulo's algorithm and a 7-stage pipeline suitable for FPGA deployment.
ideas.title: RISC-V Superscalar Out-of-Order Core
ideas.why_it_could_win: Addresses hardcore hardware design, directly mirroring the SanDisk Hardware Hackathon winning pattern of deep architectural implementation.

ideas.pitch: A web platform that predicts harmful algal bloom risks days in advance using localized sensor data streams and machine learning models.
ideas.title: Aquatic Algal Bloom Risk Predictor
ideas.why_it_could_win: Matches the proven success of the AquaSense IoT Hackathon by turning sensor telemetry into actionable predictive insights for environmental safety.

ideas.pitch: An edge-deployed computer vision garbage classifier using microcontroller hardware and custom Python models to automate sorting in real-time.
ideas.title: AI-Powered Smart Garbage Classifier
ideas.why_it_could_win: Uses physical computing and live demonstration, echoing the TechnoMorph Hackathon runner-up that impressed judges with working robotics and hardware integration.
